criteria.name: Identity
criteria.basis: Actual first-person terrain and supplied blue-green/earth/mineral palette retain the quiet sandbox identity; no model/body/tool overlay.

criteria.name: Objects/materials
criteria.basis: Eight actual blocks now show user-provided granular/mottled/faceted imagery; chalk, cyan, amber-in-rock and purple-in-dark-rock distinguishable. Cube silhouettes stay flat/rectilinear.

criteria.name: Background
criteria.basis: Actual start and rendered underground/tunnel surfaces remain visible and calm. Plain sky and repeated finite boundary are simple rather than rich.

criteria.name: UI integration
criteria.basis: Actual390/320/landscape images retain8named/count-bearing cards with matching thumbnail samples and distinct selected framing; no newly clipped labels observed.

criteria.name: Composition
criteria.basis: Centered target and editable world remain focal. Short landscape still devotes a substantial fraction to controls/palette, an existing practical compromise.

criteria.name: Readability
criteria.basis: Matched after overlays show dark target outline over chalk, light angular crack over dark crystal, clear aim and contrasting valid/invalid ghosts. This score uses real screenshots after the recorded contrast fix.

criteria.name: Motion/effects evidence
criteria.basis: Progress-stage overlay and oblique camera keyframes retain readable textures. No continuous video perceptual evaluation, physical motion comfort or sound experience was performed; no credit inferred from shader source.

criteria.name: Finish
criteria.basis: Supplied material family, improved targets and faithful small icons feel coherent in viewed screens. Repeated macro motifs, especially amber/deepstone source coarseness and simple background limit polish; not a claim of seamless photorealism.

comparison: Before baseline02 gallery versus final candidate03 gallery uses identical eight positions and camera; supplied details replace procedural few-pixel patterns.
Original and processed contacts/repeat images were opened during initial review; user texture source variations remain recognizable.
All6actual cube faces contain stone rather than a missing/other material; original obstructed negative-Y image is preserved separately.

Final selected-mip linear filtering keyframes retain recognizable near texture and soft far tone separation; no blue contamination on chalk edges observed. This static review cannot prove absence of temporal flicker.
